detail:
Key (NEW): R1b|fnn-immutable-close-handle|*fnn-immutable-close-debts*:unlocked-write @ host/native/io.lisp:5403.

Trace: fnn-immutable-close-handle (io.lisp:5399-5405) pushes a debt vector with a bare push on the process-global; fnn-immutable-close-observation (io.lisp:5397) reads it. Callers io.lisp:4033, :4055 and immutable-publish.lisp:26 run on any actor that stages a write (24+ fnn-write-staged call sites across bp-service, bp-node, bp, auth-admin, consumer-local, tcpcl, peer-invite, workflow), no common lock.

Hazard: two threads failing a close at once can lose a debt (non-atomic push on a global), and a writer that passed the observation just before a push proceeds, so the rule 'once any close is uncertain stop all staged writes' is broken by one operation. The sibling *fnn-publication-close-debts* (io.lisp:5080-5120) has the same shape and was not flagged: check it in the same repair.
fix: Guard the debts list and the observation with one mutex (declare it in lock_discipline_contracts.json), or an atomic push (compare-and-swap) with the observation read in the same section as the open; apply to both globals.
notes: Fixed at cb032de77: both close-debt lists (immutable and publication) are pushed and observed under *fnn-close-debts-lock* (lock XCLOSEDEBT, edges O->XCLOSEDEBT and E->XCLOSEDEBT declared). Key R1b|fnn-immutable-close-handle|*fnn-immutable-close-debts*:unlocked-write gone, none added. natives_owed: tests/native_immutable_close_source.lisp, tests/native_bp_lock_return_source.lisp, tests/native_log_terminal_source.lisp, tests/native_io_progress_raw.lisp.
title: *fnn-immutable-close-debts* is pushed and read with no lock from concurrent staged writers (R1b)
